subject.title: Session reset on abort settle timeout causes complete context loss (session amnesia)

question: Should abort-timeout takeover recovery automatically carry prior transcript context into the replacement session, and what exact auth/channel/thread/reset boundaries must constrain that replay?
rationale: The source shows a real session-state failure path, but carrying transcript context across sessions is security-sensitive and overlaps an open takeover/message-delivery PR, so automation should not choose the product boundary alone.

options.title: Bounded same-scope recovery
options.body: Preserve or summarize a small replay tail only when the replacement session has the same session key, auth profile, channel/thread, and no explicit clean-reset boundary; this best matches the issue while containing leakage risk.

options.title: Resend-only takeover recovery
options.body: Accept the related PR's resend guidance as the immediate fix and keep context migration as a separate follow-up if users still report amnesia.

options.title: No automatic replay
options.body: Keep session reset as a hard boundary and improve diagnostics/user-facing recovery copy instead of carrying context across sessions.

recommendation.title: Bounded same-scope recovery
recommendation.body: Preserve or summarize a small replay tail only when the replacement session has the same session key, auth profile, channel/thread, and no explicit clean-reset boundary; this best matches the issue while containing leakage risk.
